name: Antom (Ant International — Alipay+ / Alipay / WeChat Pay acquiring)

webhook.algorithm: Signature header with a structured value: algorithm=RSA256,keyVersion=1,signature=<url-encoded base64>. Verification is SHA256withRSA against ANTOM'S PUBLIC KEY (asymmetric — you do NOT share an HMAC secret), over a content string built from httpMethod + requestPath + clientId + Request-Time + rawBody. The Request-Time header is an ISO-8601 timestamp with offset and IS part of the signed content, so a tolerance window is enforceable. Docs explicitly warn: use the HTTP body directly, never re-serialize the JSON. VERIFIED from docs.antom.com/ac/ams/digital_signature and /ac/cashierpay/notificati

evidence.note: Catalog import from adversarially-checked research. The scheme above is quoted from that research and has NOT been transcribed into typed fields, so PagoKit will not generate a verifier. Promoting this provider to generic or build means reading the provider docs and typing the scheme in.

credentials.note: Not an sk_/pk_ model at all. Credentials are a Client-Id plus an RSA KEY PAIR: you upload your public key and hold the private key for request signing; you download Antom's public key to verify responses and notifications. Generated code mu

fees.notes: UNKNOWN — Antom quotes per merchant and per wallet; no public rate card. Do not emit a number.

notes: One integration reaches Alipay, WeChat Pay and the whole Alipay+ wallet network (GCash, TNG, DANA, TrueMoney, KakaoPay and ~25 others) — the single highest-leverage entry in the cluster. It is also the only provider here using asymmetric RSA signing, which no shipped template covers.

SDKs: Official SDKs exist for Java, PHP, Node and Python under the Antom/Alipay open-platform orgs, but they are lower-traffic than Western equivalents and the signing helper is the main reason to use them. Do not hand-roll RSA signing if an SDK signing tool is available.
Developer-experience scores are unrated placeholders (3/3); they are not used in ranking.
Overlaps: Supersedes trying to integrate Alipay and WeChat Pay separately. Also now the parent of 2C2P — if you add Antom, 2C2P becomes a redundancy rather than an addition for most merchants.
Onboarding: sales_gated. Ant International enterprise onboarding.
